subject: EU-only processing: geofence attestation, VPC fallback & runbook request
messages:
From: Lukas Hoffmann <lukas.h@eurosafelabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:12:00Z
Subject: Geofence attestation & VPC fallback for EU-only processing

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement and DPIA for the new AI assistant project we need a clear written attestation that all processing for our customer data can be restricted to EU regions and to a customer-designated VPC/non-public connector. Specifically: 

- Confirmation of a technical geofence (regional routing) and the mechanism used (region tag, routing policy, etc.)
- Whether Redwood can commit to no cross-border fallback and, if fallback is required, what the audit/evidence will look like
- A draft operations runbook we can review that describes provisioning, change control, and incident playbooks while in EU-only mode
- SIG/CAIQ or SOC2 artifacts that show encryption, key management (HSM/KMS), and logging for egress/audit trails

I attached our filled SIG questionnaire to this mail (Eurosafe_SIG-Questionnaire-20261129.pdf). Please confirm what you can provide and an estimated timeline — our procurement window closes in mid-December.

Best,
Lukas Hoffmann
Head of Security, Eurosafe Labs
[attachment: Eurosafe_SIG-Questionnaire-20261129.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Hoffmann <lukas.h@eurosafelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Geofence attestation & VPC fallback for EU-only processing

Hi Lukas — thanks for the detail and for sending the SIG. We can absolutely support an EU-only processing posture for Eurosafe Labs. High level: 

- Regional routing: we can pin processing to the EU region using our routing policy + model variant pinning. Requests from your tenant will be routed to EU capacity pools by default.
- VPC connector & private deployment: Redwood Private (VPC) provides a private control plane and customer-managed connectors. For on-prem or air-gapped needs we also offer an on-prem package (separate SOW).
- Cross-border fallback: by default we do not route outside region; however, under extreme capacity constraints automated fallback policies exist. We can disable fallback for your tenant and provide an attestation letter to that effect.

Next steps I propose:
1) We prepare a short attestation letter (legal) + runbook draft describing provisioning and change-control for EU-only mode.
2) Ben can share the technical runbook and checklist for required customer config (VPC peering, firewall rules, KMS/HSM integration).
3) Rishi will coordinate the SIG/SOC2 artifact bundle and point to a secure Drive share.

Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow (2026-11-30) to walk the runbook and timeline? If that works, Ben will bring the VPC runbook draft.

Thanks — we aim to have the runbook + evidence bundle ready by Dec 6 so you have time for procurement.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Hoffmann <lukas.h@eurosafelabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Geofence attestation & VPC fallback for EU-only processing — runbook draft

Lukas / Monica — attaching the initial runbook draft and a short evidence checklist. Highlights from the draft: 

- Provisioning: tenant created with region tag = eu-west-1, all model variants pinned to eu pool.
- Networking: VPC connector established using customer's transit VPC; required inbound/outbound egress rules listed in section 2.
- Key management: we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and HSM-backed keys for private deployments; for Hosted we provide tenant-scoped KMS.
- Auditing: all egress and cross-region routing events are recorded in our audit logs and retained per the SOW; we can deliver exported CSVs for the procurement review.
- Fallback: we can toggle fallback policies per-tenant. Default for Eurosafe: disabled (no cross-border fallback).

Attachments: vpc-runbook-draft.md (text), sccs-evidence-checklist.csv

Let me know specific items you want expanded in the runbook. If you want an on-prem fallback plan, we should scope it as an add-on SOW (timelines vary).

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: vpc-runbook-draft.md (text/markdown)]

From: Lukas Hoffmann <lukas.h@eurosafelabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, legal@eurosafelabs.com
Date: 2026-12-01T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Geofence attestation & VPC fallback for EU-only processing

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 09:45 Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Lukas / Monica — attaching the initial runbook draft and a short evidence checklist. Highlights from the draft:
> ...

Thanks — appreciate the detail. A couple of clarifying asks from our side after an internal DPIA review: 

1) Egress logging: We need confirmation that egress/audit logs include per-request routing decisions (timestamp, tenant-id, model-variant, chosen-host-region) and that these logs are immutable/append-only.
2) If fallback is disabled and capacity is saturated, what is the expected behavior? Will requests queue, return a specific HTTP error code, or degrade gracefully? We need failure-mode semantics documented for SLA purposes.
3) For your KMS/HSM options: for Hosted customers using tenant-scoped KMS, can we get a key rotation window and proof that keys are not replicated outside EU?

We attached a short DPIA note (Eurosafe_DPIA-notes-20261201.docx) and would like a signed attestation letter that states "Redwood will not route Eurosafe Labs customer data outside EU regions for production workloads unless explicitly authorized in writing." Can you provide a template attestation?

Also — procurement prefers a DocuSign for the SOW and attestation.

Thanks,
Lukas
Head of Security, Eurosafe Labs
[attachment: Eurosafe_DPIA-notes-20261201.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Hoffmann <lukas.h@eurosafelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Geofence attestation & VPC fallback for EU-only processing — attestation & next steps

Lukas — thanks, and good questions. Summary / commitments and next steps below: 

Commitments we can provide now: 
- Attestation: we will provide a signed attestation letter that states: "Redwood Inference will not route Eurosafe Labs production customer data outside EU regions for processing, unless explicit written authorization is provided by Eurosafe Labs." Draft attached and ready for legal review.
- Egress/audit logs: per-request routing metadata (timestamp, tenant-id, model-variant, host-region, routing-decision) is recorded; logs are retained per the SOW and exported as immutable append-only files for compliance review.
- Failure mode with fallback disabled: requests will receive a 503 (service_unavailable) with a clear retry window; the behavior and SLA exceptions will be documented in Section 7 of the runbook. We will include guidance for graceful degradation.
- KMS: for Hosted tenant-scoped KMS we can guarantee keys are stored and used in EU regions only. For HSM-backed private deployments we can provide a KMS architecture diagram and rotation window (30 days recommended).

Action items: 
1) Ben to update runbook with the log schema and failure-mode docs by Dec 4.
2) Rishi to push SIG/SOC2 evidence to a secure Drive link and flag HSM artifacts for legal review.
3) Monica to circulate attestation template + SOW for signature via HelloSign/DocuSign.

I will attach the attestation draft and create the DocuSign request this afternoon. If procurement needs a stamped corporate letter we can provide that as well. Proposed delivery: attestation + runbook updates + evidence bundle by EOD Dec 6.

Would you like a short call tomorrow to confirm the DocuSign and evidence link? I'll block 30 minutes.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_attestation-draft-Eurosafe.pdf (application/pdf)]
